absences: NRC Part 57 final rule (due 2026-11-23): not checked, skipped per skip/recently-checked.md (settled as proposed). No final rule found in search; ANS 2026-10-22 still describes it as proposed.

Dominion Virginia 2026 IRP update (filed with the SCC 2026-10-15): filing confirmed by a fetched SELC release dated 2026-10-16 ('Yesterday, Dominion Energy filed its 2026 Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) update with the State Corporation Commission (SCC).'). The 2 GW SMR figure appears only in search summaries; no fetched page states it (Virginia Mercury and newsfromthestates returned 403; the wdbj7 fetch says the nuclear share is not broken out). Docket number not found. Not filed as a Type F record. Follow-up: pull the SCC docket for the 2026 IRP and read its SMR line.
Georgia PSC: no 2026 SMR-specific docket found. Georgia Power's Sept 2026 Vogtle/Hatch uprate and NU-1 tariff filings are large-reactor uprates, out of the 1-20 MW band.
Alaska RCA: no microreactor docket found for Copper Valley or Golden Valley. DEC siting permits and NRC licensing are the operative venues per search results.

NRC Commission votes on advanced reactors dated 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-20: none found. Most recent NRC action in results is the Dow/X-energy Long Mott construction permit (2026-11-09 or 11-10), already in skip/news.json.

FY2027 NDAA: House committee text (H.R. 8800, HASC 44-12) includes a Harrigan amendment for a transportable microreactor (50 MW or less) in Indo-Pacific Command. Floor passage, Senate text and conference outcome not found. No dated in-window event.

FY2027 Energy and Water (H.R. 9022, House committee report H.Rept. 119-667, 2026-04-22): Office of Nuclear Energy microreactor line not found; Senate summary excerpt did not include the Office of Nuclear Energy. Outside window.
Army Janus five selections (2026-08-26): dated and already shipped in skip/news.json (army-janus-* ids). Not refiled.

Texas HB 14 / TANEO: TANEO page lists no announced HB 14 grant awards (selections were projected for the week of 2026-07-20; first award period as early as 2026-09-14). Page cites a $120M ANCRP reimbursement cap, which does not contradict the shipped $350M fund figure. Award status unverified.

Alaska SB 177 (2022): WNN fetched (2023-07-28) confirms the 50 MW definition. The shipped sentence on legislative siting approval is consistent with that article. Not written as a check because the only fetched source is a 2023 secondary article.

What states did in 2025 (INL, as of 2025-12-01: 279 bills, 73 enacted): no newer INL report found. NCSL and NEI summaries give different 2025-26 counts (NEI: over 60 measures enacted in the past 12 months). Shipped figures left as is.

DOE Reactor Pilot Program four criticals by July 4 (Antares 2026-06-04, Valar 2026-06-18, Deployable 2026-06-30, Aalo CTR 2026-07-04 12:20 MT): POWER (2026-07-06) fetched and confirms the dates, but it is trade press, not a DOE primary, so it is not written as a confirmed check. Aalo naming is settled in recently-checked.md.
New Jersey: P.L.2026 c.9 (signed 2026-04-08) and Power NJ Act (2026-07-13) are outside the 90-day window and large-reactor scale. skip/dockets.json already lists the NJ S4849 and A5727 bills.
CNSC (Canada): no SMR or microreactor licence decision found after the April 2025 Darlington construction licence.
Companion NRC rule for DOE/DOW-authorized designs (proposed 2026-04-02, comment period closed 2026-05-04) and Part 57 proposal (91 FR 23628, 2026-05-01): no new November 2026 NRC proposed rule found.
Budget: about 20 web searches and 7 fetches used. Two HTTP 403s (newsfromthestates.com, virginiamercury.com) limited the Dominion check. Search summaries were not used as quotes.
